dialect.detail: IBM CICS TS COBOL3 dialect; CBL CICS('COBOL3') APOST compiler option; uses EXEC CICS commands including INQUIRE TASK, INQUIRE PROGRAM, INQUIRE TRANSACTION, WRITEQ TS/TD, GET CONTAINER/CHANNEL (z/OS Connect / CICS TS 6.4+); EIB fields used

purpose.domain_detail: CICS resource inquiry controller; acts as a front-end dispatcher for a catalog/VSRS application, routing requests based on STARTCODE (terminal 3270 or DPL/z/OS Connect) and performing CICS INQUIRE on programs and transactions
purpose.summary: VSRS0000 is a CICS online controller program that receives requests either from a 3270 terminal or via DPL/z/OS Connect channel-container, evaluates a service code (RC01/RC02), and dispatches to CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM or INQUIRE TRANSACTION to return resource metadata. It is modelled after the IBM DFH0XCMN Catalog Manager sample but customised for a VSRS application.

notable_features: EXEC CICS INQUIRE TASK with STARTCODE
EXEC CICS INQUIRE PROGRAM (CHANGEUSRID, INSTALLUSRID, LIBRARY, LIBRARYDSN)
EXEC CICS INQUIRE TRANSACTION (PROGRAM, PROFILE, TRANCLASS)
EXEC CICS GET CONTAINER / CHANNEL for z/OS Connect (BW-WAS-ADAPTER)
EXEC CICS WRITEQ TS debug queue ('VALTER')
EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD to CSSL for error logging
verdict.notes: File is named CICSCON0.cbl but PROGRAM-ID is VSRS0000 and comments reference DFH0XCMN (IBM sample). This appears to be a customised derivative of the IBM CICS TS Example Application Catalog Manager. The debug WRITEQ TS to queue 'VALTER' and Portuguese-language comments/error messages suggest a Brazilian IBM shop customisation. No COPY statements present; all structures defined inline. Max line length 72 confirms strict fixed format.
